research_attempts.query_text: Joseph E Turcotte; NARA OSS index and official Archives context; CIA Reading Room or equivalent official-source check; exact-name and meaningful variants; OSS, Army, rank and unit clues; employer and occupation 1940; obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory, Library of Congress and archival searches; Boxes 365 and 789-790; protected identifiers used only when defensible
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Unbridged namesakes, search snippets, unsourced genealogy, people-finder pages, postwar-only employment leads and sources without an OSS, protected-identifier or personnel-file bridge were rejected.
